words.prose: {{ar:قٓ}} ({{tr:qāf}}) opens as a single sounded sign before any ordinary sentence begins. In the standard local form it remains an undeclined muqatta'a letter, but the supplied qira'at make the letter grammatically legible in three directions: genitive {{ar:قَافِ}} ({{tr:qāfi}}) can pull it toward the oath scope, accusative {{ar:قَافَ}} ({{tr:qāfa}}) treats it as a case-bearing item, and nominative {{ar:قَافُ}} ({{tr:qāfu}}) protects its independent nominal stance. The payoff is not to choose a hidden lexical definition, but to hear an unresolved alphabetic beat followed by the oath beat; the same qāf onset then reappears in {{ar:ٱلْقُرْءَانِ}} ({{tr:al-qurʾāni}}), so the opening sound expands into the named recitation without being reduced to it.

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is the hinge that turns the opening from the isolated {{ar:قٓ}} ({{tr:qāf}}) into a governed oath phrase. Its following genitive selects oath force, so the particle does more than coordinate: it makes {{ar:ٱلْقُرْءَانِ}} ({{tr:al-qurʾāni}}) the sworn object while still connecting the two opening beats. Because the response to the oath is absent inside 50:1, the word also projects syntax forward; 50:2 can be heard as a possible uptake of the slot the oath has opened. In recitation the proclitic flows into {{ar:ٱلْقُرْءَانِ}} ({{tr:al-qurʾāni}}), so the dependency is audible as a bound particle-to-noun phrase rather than a loose word pair.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْقُرْءَانِ}} ({{tr:al-qurʾāni}}) is the governed oath object, not an imperative or a causative act. Its definite nominal form lets the root's reciting action stand as a stable recognized title: the sworn object is voiced recitation and gathered discourse at once, while farther q-r-ʾ branches such as biological periods or greeting formulae remain outside the local sense. The shared genitive with {{ar:ٱلْمَجِيدِ}} ({{tr:al-majīdi}}) means the oath is by the Quran specifically as majīd, and the final -i cadence makes that noun-adjective bond audible. The internal hamza keeps a recitational catch inside the title, while the easing variant {{ar:وٰالْقُرَانِ}} ({{tr:wa-l-qurāni}}) shows that the sound texture can shift without changing the referent. The word also threads the surah: the object sworn by in 50:1 returns as the instrument for reminding in 50:45, while the Quran-with-attribute opener belongs to a wider formula family (15:87, 36:2, 38:1) and the majīd pairing has a supplied parallel (85:21).

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمَجِيدِ}} ({{tr:al-majīdi}}) locks onto {{ar:ٱلْقُرْءَانِ}} ({{tr:al-qurʾāni}}) by definiteness, gender, number, and genitive case, so the oath lands on the Quran as majīd rather than on a detached praise word. The adjective can be discussed as an attached na't, while a khabar reading would reopen the ending as an elided-predicate assertion; locally the attachment evidence keeps the modifier route primary. Its fa'il shape makes majesty and amplitude a durable quality, not a contest of glory, a reflexive self-display, or a passing action. The m-j-d field keeps the gloss from flattening to prestige alone: glory, generosity, and abundance converge, with the pasturage image contributing concrete fullness without making the Quran literal pasture. The rarity also matters: supplied uses tie majīd to the Quran (50:1; 85:21), throne context (85:15), and divine address (11:73), so the final word gives the oath object a marked attribute seal while the same Quran referent later becomes the reminder instrument in 50:45.

topics.reason: The qualitative adjective form supports a durable attribute reading in the local noun phrase.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun ٱلْقُرْءَانِ (ق ر ء) and its adjective ٱلْمَجِيدِ (م ج د).
baseline_models.mechanism: The oath presents reading or recitation as the carrier of attained honor, generosity, and elevation; majesty belongs to the discourse as recited, not only to an external subject it describes.

activation_trace.role: Reading, recitation, and teaching supply the discourse event that the oath foregrounds.
Attained honor, generosity, and elevation qualify the recited discourse with intrinsic worth.

changed_reading.before: An oath by a named text that is conventionally called glorious.
changed_reading.after: An oath by a recited discourse whose voiced form itself bears elevated honor and generosity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The gathering branch of ق ر ء joined to the fullness and multiplied-gift branches of م ج د.
baseline_models.mechanism: Gathering makes the Qur'an an ordered concentration of parts, while majid makes that concentration ample enough to satisfy and generous enough to exceed what it contains.

activation_trace.role: Gathering and joining supply the compositional action by which dispersed parts become one Qur'an.
Bodily and pasture-fed fullness makes the gathered composition nourishing and sufficient rather than merely prestigious.
Multiplication of gift and favor turns fullness outward as an abundance that can be given.

changed_reading.before: Majid adds a general honorific to the Qur'an.
changed_reading.after: The Qur'an is a gathered plenitude whose majesty consists in dense sufficiency and multiplying benefit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The time-that-arrives branch of ق ر ء and the multiplying-favor branch of م ج د.
baseline_models.mechanism: Qur'an can be heard not only as something read but as a recital whose due time arrives; majid gives that arrival weight and productive excess.

activation_trace.role: A time that comes near, arrives, or is delayed supplies an appointed-event contour inside Qur'an.
Multiplied favor makes the appointed recital consequential and recurrently productive.

changed_reading.before: The Qur'an is a stable object available for reading.
changed_reading.after: The Qur'an is also an appointed recital: each reading can make a due event arrive.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The way or exemplar branch of ق ر ء and the magnification-by-mention branch of م ج د.
baseline_models.mechanism: The paired branches permit a performative reading: the Qur'an supplies a way or model, and following or voicing that model enacts magnification through the mention of excellence.

activation_trace.role: A way, exemplar, or intended course makes the Qur'an a pattern to traverse rather than only content to inspect.
Magnifying by naming excellent qualities makes recitation an enactment of the majesty it announces.

changed_reading.before: The opening describes an already majestic text.
changed_reading.after: The opening may also initiate a patterned practice whose recitation performs magnification.

context_deltas.mechanism: The gathering branch of Qur'an is sharpened from compositional assembly into an archive: entries are registered and guarded, speech is received as soon as it is emitted, its record stands ready, and substitution is denied.

activation_trace.role: Gathering supplies the focus-side operation that the context recasts as archival collection.
Entering a name into a register supplies cataloguing and gives the gathering an archival form.
Guarding and watchful preservation keep what has been gathered from loss.
Receiving speech as transmission supplies the intake stage of the collection mechanism.
The tongue's emission of speech supplies the discrete material that enters the archive.
What is present and prepared makes each received utterance immediately available for witness.
Replacement by one thing standing for another supplies the explicitly negated failure mode of the archive.

structural_cues: 50:4 places a guarded book beside the earth's loss of bodily matter.
50:17-18 sequence reception, utterance, surveillance, and readiness.
50:29 closes the record sequence by denying substitution of the word.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies registration, guarding, reception, emitted speech, readiness, and non-replacement; I connect them as one collection-and-preservation pipeline. A live alternative is that they describe divine accounting without identifying the Qur'an itself as that archive.

changed_reading.before: The Qur'an is a completed collection of recited units.
changed_reading.after: Its gatheredness can also name a living, guarded archive in which utterance and embodied trace remain present without substitution.

context_deltas.mechanism: Joining in construction, ordered stacking, reviving dead land, bringing the hidden outward, opening the earth, and driving a dispersed multitude to one destination turn Qur'anic gathering into a model of re-creation.

activation_trace.role: Gathering and joining anchor the reassembly mechanism directly in the focus noun.
Fullness produced by ample feeding gives the reassembled order a living, bodily density.
Building by joining parts supplies the constructive form of gathering.
Joining things in ordered alignment supplies visible organization rather than an undifferentiated heap.
Earth's life through rain and growth makes ordered gathering biologically productive.
Bringing a thing out of concealment supplies emergence as the result of revived assembly.
Splitting and opening supplies the release of what the earth had enclosed.
Driving and collecting a multitude toward one destination completes the focus root's gathering image.

structural_cues: 50:6-11 moves from joined construction through ordered growth to reviving a dead land and emergence.
50:44 answers that ecological sequence with opened earth and rapid gathering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies joined building, ordered stacking, revived earth, emergence, opened ground, and destination-gathering; I treat their sequence as one reassembly grammar and map it back to ق ر ء. They may instead remain evidentiary analogies for resurrection without characterizing the Qur'an's own gathered form.

changed_reading.before: Qur'an is gathered language and majid is its honorific fullness.
changed_reading.after: The opening's gathered, full Qur'an becomes a verbal analogue of ordered re-creation: parts are joined, enlivened, released, and collected to an end.

context_deltas.mechanism: Return, the repeatedly named Day, a warning fixed to an appointment, recurrent time-counting, return to a destination, and final outcome activate the focus branch of a time that comes due. Recitation becomes a present arrival of the promised return.

activation_trace.role: A time that approaches, arrives, or is delayed anchors the temporal reading in Qur'an itself.
Return to a prior state supplies the event whose due time the recital announces.
A day's decisive event and severity concentrate diffuse future time into an arrival.
An appointment fixing a promise to time or place makes the warning calendrical rather than indefinite.
A count of time and its recurrence reinforces the temporal cycle latent in the warning root's split mapping.
The annual cycle supplies a larger recurring measure for the appointed-event reading.
Return to a homeward destination gives the due event a repeated directional pull.
Becoming toward a final outcome supplies the terminus at which the appointed recital arrives.

structural_cues: The surah repeatedly concentrates its claims in ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ and يَوْمَ formulas.
Return language begins at 50:3 and reaches explicit destination language at 50:43.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies return, Day, appointed warning, recurrent counting, homeward return, and outcome; I infer that recitation makes this temporal structure present rather than merely describing it. The conservative alternative keeps ق ر ء strictly as reading and treats the timing as a surrounding rhetorical frame.

changed_reading.before: The Qur'an reports a future return.
changed_reading.after: The Qur'an's recital is itself an appointed arrival, repeatedly bringing the promised return into the hearer's present.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recitation is revised from vocal production alone into a two-sided summons: understanding hearing and present witness answer a raised call, then the final cry makes hearing unavoidable.

activation_trace.role: Reading and recitation supply the voiced address that the context converts into a hearing event.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies the receptive action demanded by recitation.
Presence with witnessing prevents hearing from remaining detached acoustic reception.
The raised voice and call project recitation outward as a summons from a determinate source.
Auditory perception supplies the final compulsory reception that answers earlier voluntary listening.
The terrifying cry supplies the eschatological endpoint of the recitation-to-hearing trajectory.

structural_cues: 50:37 binds reminder to a heart or deliberately offered hearing while present as witness.
50:41 commands listening before 50:42 states universal hearing of the cry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies understanding hearing, witnessed presence, a raised caller, ordinary auditory perception, and a terrifying cry; I align them as stages of one summons. They may instead be separate instructions and events, with no claim that Qur'anic recitation anticipates the final cry.

changed_reading.before: Qur'an denotes discourse that a reciter voices.
changed_reading.after: Qur'an becomes a summons completed only in present, understanding hearing and culminating in a call that all must hear.

context_deltas.mechanism: Stable growing good and allotted nourishment first materialize majid as provision; the later contrast between a container asking whether it is full and repeated 'more' makes this fullness dynamically inexhaustible rather than closed.

activation_trace.role: Fullness from ample pasture or feeding anchors majesty in material sufficiency.
Multiplying gift turns that fullness into outwardly available favor.
Good that remains fixed and grows supplies durable productivity to majid's fullness.
An allotted gift identifies the growing abundance as provision for recipients.
Fullness that matches a container supplies the finite boundary against which majid's surplus is tested.
Increase and growth turn completed filling into an appetite for further addition.
Carrying provision for a transition makes the non-dominant split root's 'more' a journey-sustaining surplus.

structural_cues: 50:9-11 turns descending water into growth and provision.
50:30 asks whether Hell is full and immediately asks for more, while 50:35 places more with God after fulfilled desire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies growing good, allotted gift, container-filling, increase, and journey provision; I infer a contrast between devouring appetite and beneficent surplus and map the latter to majid. The two 'more' scenes may instead characterize separate destinations without modifying the opening adjective.

changed_reading.after: Majid marks inexhaustible provision: the gathered Qur'an is full enough to nourish yet remains capable of further gift.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final frame denies coercive force and assigns the Qur'an the work of reminder for one already responsive to warning. The opening's majesty is therefore authority exercised through recollection and recognition, not domination.

activation_trace.role: Recitation supplies the communicative act whose mode of authority the closing frame specifies.
Honor and noble elevation supply authority that need not be reduced to force.
Coercion and compulsion supply the explicitly negated model of Qur'anic authority.
A reminder that makes one remember supplies the positive operation replacing compulsion.
Fear anticipating harm identifies an inwardly responsive audience rather than an externally forced one.
Threat and warning supply the remembered consequence to which that audience responds.

structural_cues: The final ayah repeats the opening Qur'an lexeme and therefore frames the whole-surah package.
The closing sequence places negated compulsion immediately before the command to remind and limits uptake to one who fears the warning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies negated compulsion, reminder, anticipatory fear, and warning; I let the closing recurrence govern how the opening majid exercises authority. A live alternative is that 50:45 defines only the messenger's method, not the semantic force of majid.

changed_reading.before: A majestic Qur'an may suggest authority through overwhelming power.
changed_reading.after: Its majesty is non-coercive authority: recitation recalls a warning whose force depends on recognition, attention, and inward response.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the womb branch of ق ر ء through branch-distant garden, cord, and nearness images. It remains anchored in the focus noun's explicit womb-gathering branch and in the packet's concealment-to-opening-to-emergence sequence. Downstream prose should present it only as a gestational material analogy for resurrection, not as the lexical definition of Qur'an or as a claim that the cited garden and vein literally mean fetus and pregnancy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The branch of ق ر ء in which a womb gathers and holds a pregnancy, reinforced by the bodily fullness branch of م ج د.

activation_trace.role: A womb gathering blood or fetus supplies the gestational container directly from the focus root.
Bodily fullness from ample nourishment makes the container fecund rather than merely enclosing.
A fetus hidden in the belly supplies concealed life inside the gestational analogy.
Pregnancy extending in the belly supplies a bodily line of held development.
Nearness of birth gives hidden development an approaching release point.
Splitting open supplies the birth-like rupture of the enclosing earth.
Bringing the hidden outward supplies emergence from the gestational enclosure.

changed_reading.before: Qur'an is a gathered verbal collection.
changed_reading.after: At an exploratory material level, its gathering resembles gestation: dispersed life is held, nourished, brought near, and released when the earth opens.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the fire-producing branch of م ج د is proverbial and the flame branch of م ر ج is distant from the surface sense of confused. It remains branch-resolvable and anchored in the focus adjective, with filling and increase sustaining a coherent combustion image. Downstream prose should call it a secondary kindling analogy only, never define majid as fiery or claim that the Qur'an causes or feeds Hell.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The fire-increasing branch of م ج د, with the gathering branch of ق ر ء supplying concentrated fuel as an analogy.

activation_trace.role: Proverbial abundance of firewood and readiness for ignition supply the focus-side kindling image.
Gathering concentrates otherwise separate material and therefore supports the contained fuel analogy.
A darting flame supplies the packet-side ignition echo inside the branch inventory of confusion.
Filling to the container's measure supplies the apparent saturation point of the fire image.
Further increase after filling supplies the image of combustion that continues to demand addition.

changed_reading.before: Majid means statically great or honorable.
changed_reading.after: As a contained outlier, majid briefly evokes concentrated kindling: gathered speech carries latent ignition beside a reckoning that asks for further filling.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the greeting branch of ق ر ء is secondary and the greeting branch of ح ي ي is remote from the surface causative 'we give life.' It remains anchored in the focus root's explicit reading-or-sending of peace and is coherently answered by entry in peace and abiding life. Downstream prose should render it as a salutational undertone crossing the warning, not as a replacement translation of Qur'an.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The peace-greeting branch of ق ر ء joined to the multiplying-gift branch of م ج د.

activation_trace.role: Reading or sending a greeting of peace supplies a salutational possibility inside the focus noun.
Multiplying gift makes the greeting a generous grant rather than a bare formula.
Entering an interior supplies the threshold across which the greeting is received.
Safety and freedom from harm supply the greeting's realized content.
Enduring stability keeps the received peace from quickly passing away.
A greeting that invokes life and peace supplies the final verbal echo of the focus greeting branch.

changed_reading.before: The majestic Qur'an warns its hearer.
changed_reading.after: Beneath the warning, an exploratory branch hears a generous greeting being sent toward entry in safe and abiding life.

strongest_changes: ق ر ء as gathering became both a guarded archive of utterance and an ordered reassembly of embodied life.
ق ر ء as recitation became a timed auditory summons whose promised event repeatedly arrives in hearing.
م ج د shifted from generic prestige toward inexhaustible provision and authority that works by reminder rather than coercion.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package let the closing recurrence of Qur'an govern the opening oath, while the long sequences of recording, ecological revival, repeated Day formulas, listening, filling, and final gathering kept several focus-root branches active at once. Split mappings in و ع د and ز ي د especially exposed temporal recurrence and journey provision that a dominant-root reading would miss.
remaining_uncertainties: The archive and re-creation mechanisms may characterize the evidence surrounding the oath more directly than the Qur'an itself.
The appointed-time model and the non-dominant split-root activations are coherent but remain branch-level possibilities, not replacement lexical glosses.
The gestational, kindling, and salutational readings require explicit analogical containment because their activating branches are distant from several source surfaces.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The recitation is a gathered whole.** The first variant of `ق ر ء:B001` supplies collecting and joining; the second supplies gathered speech as recitation. `م ج د:B001` assigns noble rank, while `م ج د:B004` offers fullness from abundance. I infer that the oath presents the discourse as an assembled, ample body whose later dispersed scenes belong together. The ayah shifts from naming a prestigious text to asserting the integrative abundance of its recited sequence.
2. **Its glory can be productive generosity.** `م ج د:B006` supplies making gift and favor abundant. The later rain, provision, reminder, and promised garden provide the distribution pattern; I infer that the Quran's majesty operates by abundant giving rather than status alone. This leaves a second reading in which `ٱلْمَجِيدِ` names communicative largesse.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 50:37 and 50:45 retrospectively made the collecting variant of `ق ر ء:B001` functional: the recitation gathers hearing, memory, warning, and response into one instrument. The final command also corrected “glory” away from display toward abundant communicative provision.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Recitation as a gathered, gapless whole.** The collecting/gathering variant of `ق ر ء B001` gives the Qurʾān the role of joined speech, and `م ج د B001` gives it noble amplitude. The nearby sequence moves from disputed speech (50:2, 50:5) to a preserving book (50:4) and then to a built sky with no fissures (50:6). Those items are supplied by the packet; I infer the analogy between textual collection and gapless construction. The oath-object consequently reads as an internally joined whole whose majesty includes structural integrity, not only elevated status.

2. **Recitation as an appointment-bearing summons.** The appointed-time variant of `ق ر ء B002` is activated by repeated arrival (`ج ي ء` in 50:2 and 50:5) and the disputed return in 50:3. The packet gives recitation, arrivals, and return; I infer that the recited whole carries an appointment toward which its warning directs the hearer. This lets *al-Qurʾān* retain its recitational reading while also sounding temporally charged: its speech does not merely describe a return but brings its appointed horizon near.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 50:6’s built sky “without fissures” unexpectedly sharpened the collecting variant of `ق ر ء B001` into gapless textual integrity. The repeated arrival in 50:2 and 50:5 also made the appointed-cycle variant of `ق ر ء B002` newly audible; the recitation carries an approaching horizon.

findings.text: Kur'an'ın şanı, sûrenin dağınık görünen sahnelerini boşluksuz bir bütün halinde toplayan ve birbirine bağlayan yapısal bir genişliği de içerir.
Buradaki şan, yalnız yüksek bir konum değil, yağmurdan hatırlatmaya kadar ileride dağıtılan iyilikleri bolca veren üretken bir cömertliktir.
Okunan söz, dönüşün yalnız haberini vermekle kalmaz; tekrarlanan geliş ve dönüş ifadeleriyle yaklaşan bir buluşma vaktini de taşır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, onur kazanmayı cömertlikte doruğa erişme, yücelik ve geniş bir eli açıklıkla birlikte kurar. Bu nedenle kolun genel çerçevesi yerindedir; ancak yalnızca toplumsal saygınlığa indirgenmemeli, cömertlik ve övülen yücelik bileşenlerini de korumalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol övülen bir niteliği ve o niteliğe erişmeyi anlatır; böbürlenme yarışını, sözle ululamayı, besleme ve ateşle ilgili kullanımları kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın ad ve sıfatlardaki onur-cömertlik çekirdeğini, bu niteliğe erişmeyi veya onu davranışlarla göstermeyi anlatan türemiş eylem kullanımlarından ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Cömertlik, onur ve yücelik bakımından övülen en yüksek düzeye erişme ya da bu düzeyi taşıma niteliğidir. Kişinin bu niteliği kazanması veya davranışlarıyla göstermesi de aynı anlam alanına bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Anlamın çekirdeği, cömertlik ve onurda övülen yüksek bir düzeye erişmek veya o düzeyi taşımaktır.
Niteliğin kapsamı, eli açıklığın genişliğiyle birlikte yücelik ve heybet bildiren nitelemelere uzanır.
Bir kişinin bu yüksek niteliğe erişmesi veya iyi davranışları sayesinde onu göstermesi, durumdan eyleme uzanan kullanımdır.

concept_map.definition: Kişilerin onur ve üstünlük iddialarını karşılaştırarak birbirlerine karşı böbürlenmesi ve bu yarışta birinin ötekine baskın gelmesidir.

facets.statement: Eylemin çekirdeği, bir kişinin ötekine kendi onur ve üstünlüğünü ileri sürerek karşılıklı övünme yarışına girmesidir.
Karşılıklı yarışın sonucu, taraflardan birinin övünme konusu olan üstünlükte diğerini geçmesi olabilir.
Topluluk bağlamında eylem, kişilerin üstünlüklerini ortaya koyarak birbirleriyle karşılıklı böbürlenmesini anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnızca tam doluluğu değil, hayvanın doygunluğa yaklaşmasını, yeterince veya karnını dolduracak kadar beslenmesini ve bol otlağa erişmesini de kapsar. concept_map.definition: Belirli hayvan ve yeme-içme söyleyişlerinde, sürünün geniş otlakta yiyip doygunluğa yaklaşması ya da hayvanın karnını yeterince dolduracak biçimde beslenmesidir. Sınırlı bir insan kullanımında yiyecek ve içeceğin çokluğunu da niteler.

facets.statement: Hayvanın bol otlakta yiyerek tam veya tama yakın doygunluğa erişmesi temel durumdur.
Ettirgen yapıda bakıcı, hayvana yetecek ya da karnını dolduracak miktarda yem verir.
İnsanla ilgili sınırlı bir nitelemede anlam, yiyecek ve içeceğin çok olmasına uzanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, iki tür tutuşturmalık ağacın ateşi bolca üretmesini ve ateş yakmaya elverişli olmasını sabit bir söyleyiş içinde anlatır. Verilen çerçeve, ateşin genel yanmasını değil bu özel ağaçların tutuşturma verimini doğru biçimde öne çıkarır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol yalnızca belirtilen sabit söyleyiş ve onun ateş çıkarma açıklamasıyla sınırlıdır; genel ateş yakma veya genel bolluk anlamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam, iki tutuşturmalık ağacın birlikte anıldığı sabit söyleyişe bağlıdır ve yalın bir çoğalma ya da ateşlenme anlamına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Sabit bir söyleyişte anılan iki tutuşturmalık ağacın bol ateş vermesi ve bu nedenle ateş yakmaya elverişli olmasıdır.

facets.statement: İki tutuşturmalık ağaç, kendilerinden bol ateş elde edilmesi bakımından birlikte nitelenir.
Bol ateş verme özelliğinin sonucu, bu ağaçların ateş tutuşturmaya elverişli olmasıdır.
Anlam, genel bir ateş olayından çok sabit bir örnek sözün özel anlatımına bağlıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar aynı sabit söyleyişi, iki tutuşturmalık ağacın ateş bakımından bol oluşu ve bu yüzden kendileriyle ateş yakılabilmesi şeklinde açıklar.

concept_gloss.text: iki tutuşturmalık ağacın bol ateş vermesi
concept_gloss.applicability: Sabit söyleyişteki iki ağacın hem ateş üretme bolluğunu hem de tutuşturma işlevini açıklamak için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İki özel ağacı, bol ateş elde edilmesini ve tutuşturmalık olma yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Bu nitelemenin sabit bir örnek söz içinde kurulmuş olduğunu tek başına belirtmez.

contextual_glosses.text: bol ateş verip tutuşturmaya elverişli olmak
contextual_glosses.applicability: Sabit söyleyişin ne anlattığını, ağaç adlarını yeniden üretmeden açık Türkçeyle vermek gereken bağlamlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bol ateş verme ile ateş tutuşturmaya elverişlilik sonucunu korur.
error_profile.loses: İki özel ağacın birlikte anılmasını ve örnek söz niteliğini açıkça taşımaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: iki tutuşturmalık ağacın bol ateş verip ateş yakmaya elverişli olması

error_profile.preserves: Ateş miktarının artması yönünü korur.
error_profile.adds: Birinin var olan ateşi büyütmesi gibi sabit söyleyişte bulunmayan genel eylemleri kapsar.
error_profile.collision: Ateşin yakıtla güçlendirilmesi anlamındaki komşu kollarla karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İki tutuşturmalık ağacın bol ateş vermesini sabit bir söyleyiş içinde yüklem olarak bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Tutuşturmalık olarak kullanılan ağaç türlerinden birini ve o ağaçtan ateş çıkarılmasını adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: ağacın ateş verimi ile tutuşturmalık ağaç
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da aynı ateş yakma ağacı alanına ve ilgili örnek söze temas eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak kol ağaç çiftinin ateş üretme niteliğini yükler; komşu kol ise tutuşturmalık ağacın kendisini adlandıran nesne koludur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tutuşturmalık ağacın bol ateş verme yeteneğini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ateşin yanması, yakılması, yükseltilmesi ve ona yanmayı güçlendiren bir şey eklenmesi eylemlerini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: ateş veren malzeme ile ateşi güçlendirme
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol ateşin başlaması veya güçlenmesi senaryosuna katılır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak kol malzemenin elverişliliği ve verimidir; komşu kol ise ateşin kendisinde gerçekleşen yanma veya yakma eylemidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirli tutuşturmalık ağaçların bol ateş çıkarma özelliğini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Var olan ateşi odun ekleyerek güçlendirme ve bir şeyi ateşle yakma eylemini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da ağaç malzemesi ile ateşin güçlenmesi arasındaki ilişkiye dayanır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak kolda ağacın doğal ateş verme niteliği öndedir; komşu kolda ise bir kişinin odunla ateşi güçlendiren eylemi öndedir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir yandan bağışı çoğaltma veya yücelik kazanmak amacıyla bol verme eylemini, öte yandan Tanrı'nın kuluna iyilik bağışladığı özel katılımcı düzenini bildirir. Kol korunabilir; ancak bu iki yön tek bir belirsiz 'iyilik' durumunda eritilmemeli, miktar artırma ile veren-alan değişimi ayrı gösterilmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol bağışın miktarını artırma veya iyilik verme eylemidir; sözlü ululamayla ve hayvana bol yem vermeyle karıştırılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Bağışı çoğaltan yapı ile Tanrı'nın kula iyilik bağışlamasını anlatan özel kullanım ayrı facetlerde tutulur; ikisi yalın bir yücelik anlamına dönüştürülmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir bağışı çoğaltmak ya da yücelik kazanmak amacıyla bolca vermektir. Özel bir dinsel kullanımda, Tanrı'nın kuluna iyilik bağışlamasını anlatır.

facets.statement: Eylemin çekirdeği, verilen bağışın miktarını artırmak veya bol miktarda vermektir.
Bol vermenin amacı, veren kişinin yüce değer ve onur kazanması olabilir.
Özel dinsel katılımcı düzeninde veren Tanrı, alan ise kuldur ve verilen şey iyiliktir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların toplu anlatımı, bağışı çoğaltmayı ve yücelik kazanma amacıyla çok vermeyi temel alır; ayrıca Tanrı'nın kula iyilik vermesini ayrı bir katılımcı düzeni olarak kaydeder.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bağış miktarını artırma çekirdeğini ve verenin çok verme eylemini birlikte anlatan genel bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bağış miktarını artırmayı ve bol verme eylemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Tanrı'nın kula iyilik bağışladığı özel katılımcı düzenini ve yücelik kazanma amacını açıkça belirtmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin belirli bir bağışın miktarını artırdığı veya onu bol hale getirdiği eylem bağlamlarına uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bağışın miktarını artıran eylemi korur.
error_profile.loses: Yücelik kazanma amacını ve Tanrı'nın kula iyilik vermesi kullanımını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tanrı'nın kula iyilik verdiği özel dinsel katılımcı düzeninde doğal ve kısa bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Verenin Tanrı, alanın kul ve verilenin iyilik olması yönünü bağlam içinde korur.
error_profile.loses: Genel bağışı çoğaltma eylemini ve bol vererek yücelik kazanma amacını kapsamaz.

error_profile.preserves: Bol verme ve eli açıklıkla ilişkili değer alanını korur.
error_profile.loses: Belirli bir bağışı çoğaltan eylemi ve veren-alan katılımcı düzenini kaybeder.
error_profile.adds: Kişinin eylemden bağımsız kalıcı karakter niteliğini ekler.
error_profile.collision: Yüksek onur ve cömertlik niteliğini anlatan birinci kolla karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Üst katılımcıdan kula doğru iyilik verme veya bağış miktarını artırma eylemidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kuldan Tanrı'ya veya başka bir varlığa yönelen sözlü ululama eylemidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol aynı dinsel ilişkide farklı yönlere giden eylemler olarak karşılaşabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak kolda aktarılan şey iyilik ve eylemin yönü alıcıya doğrudur; komşu kolda araç sözdür ve eylem yüceltilen varlığa yönelir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Var olan bağışın miktarını çoğaltma ve bol verme işlemini özellikle vurgular.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Karşılıksız iyilik etme ve zorunlu olmayan bağışta bulunma, miktarın artmasını gerektirmeden gerçekleşebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da bir verenden alıcıya iyilik veya bağış aktarılmasını anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak kolun ayırt edici ekseni miktarı artırmaktır; komşu kolun ekseni ise verilen şeyin iyilik ve karşılıksız bağış olmasıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bağışı çoğaltan veya bol veren eylemi bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Miktarı çok, kapsamı geniş veya istenen bağışın kendisini niteler.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da bağışın çokluğu ve genişliği alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak kol miktarı artıran verme eylemidir; komşu kol bu eylemin olası sonucu olan bol bağışı nesne olarak adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Verilen miktarın çoğalmasını ve bol olmasını gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyi karşılık almadan mülk olarak vermeyi bildirir ve miktarın çok olmasını gerektirmez.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da bir şeyin verenden alıcıya bağış olarak geçmesi eylemini içerebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak kol miktar eksenindedir; komşu kol ise karşılıksız mülkiyet aktarımı eksenindedir.
